title: Fall of the Berlin Wall
description:
The **Berlin Wall** fell on November 9, 1989, marking a pivotal moment in world history.

The wall had divided East and West Berlin for 28 years, serving as a symbol of the Cold War and the Iron Curtain between Western Europe and the Eastern Bloc.

On the evening of November 9, after several weeks of civil unrest, the East German government announced that all GDR citizens could visit West Germany and West Berlin. Crowds of East Germans crossed and climbed onto the Wall, joined by West Germans on the other side in a celebratory atmosphere.

The fall of the Wall paved the way for German reunification, which was formally concluded on October 3, 1990.
